CustomField.description: Beacon user persona assigned from the Title. Groups are checked in order (Competitor Intelligence, Translational, Business Development, Clinical Research, Research, Senior Leadership) and the first group with a matching keyword wins. Blank when no keyword matches. Custom field created specifically for the HubSpot integration, outside of the HubSpot managed package.

CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "insights" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "analyst" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "analytics" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "benchmarking" ) ), "Competitor Intelligence", IF( OR( CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "translation" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "biomarker" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "precision medicine" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "patient selection" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "companion diagnostic" ) ), "Translational", IF( OR( CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "business development" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "alliance" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "licensing" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "partner" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "corporate development" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "search and evaluation" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "search & evaluation" ), "acquisitions" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "investor relations" ), CONTAINS( Title, "BD" ) ), "Business Development", IF( OR( CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "clinical" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "medical" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "physician" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "investigator" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "study manager" ), CONTAINS( LOWER( Title ), "study director" ), CONTAINS(
